uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Mold Breaker
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When damaging an opposing Pokémon with an active shield effect, 30% of the damage dealt to the shield is dealt as additional damage to the target's HP. This Pokémon's hammer strengthens every time they hit Pokémon from the opposing team with boosted attacks or moves, increasing this Pokémon's Attack by 0.5% per target hit (up to 100 times; maximum 50% Attack). After the hammer is strengthened 20, 40, and 60 times; Rock Smash, Gigaton Hammer, and Smack Down gain increased range.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack after 12s, swinging the user's hammer in a circle around them, dealing increased damage and restoring 24% of the user's missing HP when it hits. This boosted attack remains readied until used. The time until the next boosted attack is readied is reduced faster when hit by opposing Pokémon's auto attacks. The hammer's size and basic attack range increase upon evolving into Tinkatuff and into Tinkaton.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Kiss Bliss Kaboom
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user first blows cute kisses at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and their nearby allies, damaging and stunning them for 1.2s when Kiss Bliss hits a target. The user can then use the Unite Move again, leaping up forward and slamming their hammer down at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect of Kaboom. Unite Move buffs apply when Kiss Bliss hits a target. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
